graph.title: Build a robot (HTML & CSS)
notes: This tutorial is a software-only web-design project (HTML and CSS in the Raspberry Pi Code Editor). It positions images such as face, eyes1 and mouth1 with CSS absolute positioning.
It has no physical parts, wires, boards, breadboard or electronic circuit, so the build graph is empty.
The images (face, eyes1/2/3, mouth1) are on-screen elements, not physical parts, so I did not model them as nodes.
